Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin yields skill with a Pearson-correlation pitfall/sanity check:

- Use 12 paired monthly nominal yield levels per calendar year.
- Compute each year’s Pearson r independently.
- Subtract full-precision correlations before rounding.
- For Treasury bonds vs New Aa corporate bonds in 1979 vs 1984, the absolute difference should be tiny, about 0.0003; 0.0385 signals wrong source/column/year sample or premature rounding.

Also compacted memory with the durable reminder:
TB ylds correlation = levels, full-r, 1979/1984 New Aa vs Treasury ≈ .0003.
